crs.title: Customer Relationship Summary (Form CRS)

facts.display: Brokerage accounts for personal and retirement investing, and cash management services such as bill pay, checkwriting and margin lending.
facts.location: Form CRS, "What investment services and advice can you provide me?"
facts.quote: FBS offers brokerage accounts and services to retail investors, including for personal and retirement investing, and cash management services (such as bill pay, checkwriting, and margin lending).

facts.display: Yes: Traditional, Roth and Rollover IRAs.
facts.location: Open an Account page, retirement accounts
facts.quote: Traditional IRA Tax deferral means your savings can potentially grow faster.

facts.display: The account-opening page says it is for persons in the U.S. only.
facts.location: Open an Account page
facts.quote: This is for persons in the US only.

facts.display: $0 to open an account. Some investments have their own minimum purchase.
facts.location: Form CRS, services section
facts.quote: There is no minimum investment to open an account; there are minimums to purchase some types of investments.

facts.display: The fee table lists $0 for IRA closeout, among other services. Check the full fee table for charges that apply to you.
facts.location: Commissions, Margin Rates, and Fees page, fee table
facts.quote: IRA closeout fee $0 Per Request

facts.display: $0 for transfer of assets.
facts.location: Commissions, Margin Rates, and Fees page, fee table
facts.quote: Transfer of assets $0 Per Transfer

facts.display: $0 for online U.S. stock and ETF trades when you work directly with Fidelity.
facts.location: Form CRS, "What fees will I pay?"
facts.quote: If you establish a retail relationship directly with FBS, there are no commissions charged on online transactions for U.S. stocks, ETFs, options, new issue bonds and certificates of deposit (“CDs”).

facts.display: $0.65 per contract for online options trades.
facts.location: Commissions, Margin Rates, and Fees page, footnotes
facts.quote: Online options trades are subject to a fee of $0.65 per contract

facts.display: Stock sell orders have an activity assessment fee, and phone or branch trades are charged a commission.
facts.location: Form CRS, "What fees will I pay?"
facts.quote: Sell orders for equities are charged an activity assessment fee and options have a per-contract fee. Transactions placed over the telephone or in a branch office are charged a commission.

facts.display: Yes, for exchange-listed U.S. stocks and ETFs on the NYSE or Nasdaq, starting at $1. Not every security is eligible.
facts.location: Fractional Shares page, FAQ
facts.quote: When trading in fractions or dollars, you can trade National Market System (NMS) exchange-listed stocks. This includes stocks and exchange-traded funds (ETFs) listed on the NYSE or Nasdaq.

facts.display: Traditional, Roth and Rollover IRAs are offered, including rolling over an old workplace plan.
facts.location: Open an Account page, retirement accounts
facts.quote: Rollover IRA Consolidate your savings by rolling over an old workplace plan.

facts.display: Provides tools and information to help you make decisions. Recommendations are available for some investments on request.
facts.location: Form CRS, services section
facts.quote: FBS, either by itself or through an affiliate, can provide you with tools and information to help you make decisions and can provide you with investment recommendations for certain investments upon request.

facts.display: Brokerage accounts are self-directed: you decide how to invest, place orders and monitor the account yourself.
facts.location: Form CRS, services section
facts.quote: you are solely responsible for deciding how you want to invest, placing orders, and monitoring your account.

facts.display: Advisory services are typically charged a fee, set out in the affiliate's own contract and disclosures. Amounts not verified here.
facts.location: Form CRS, services section
facts.quote: Investment advisory services are provided through our affiliated investment advisers … typically for a fee

facts.display: Yes. Margin interest depends on current rates and your average loan balance.
facts.location: Form CRS, "What fees will I pay?"
facts.quote: FBS will also collect fees for margin loans based on current interest rates and your average margin loan balance.

facts.display: Base margin rate 10.825%, effective September 18, 2026. See the firm's rate table for the rate at each loan size.
facts.location: Commissions, Margin Rates, and Fees page, margin rates table
facts.quote: Fidelity's current base margin rate, effective since September 18, 2026, is 10.825%.

facts.display: Unknown
facts.reason: Not described in the sources checked for this milestone. Ask what your uninvested cash earns and where it is held.
facts.to_verify: Where uninvested cash goes by default (the "core position") and what it currently earns.

facts.display: Phone: 1-800-343-3548 (listed in Form CRS). Support hours were not verified.
facts.location: Form CRS, Additional Information

facts.display: Unknown
facts.reason: Firm-specific requirements were not verified. Every broker-dealer must collect your name, date of birth, address and taxpayer identification number; see the identity verification guide.

facts.display: Not shown
facts.reason: Promotions change often and are not shown or used in comparisons. Check the firm's own site for current offers and their terms.

facts.display: Fidelity and its affiliates typically earn more when you invest in products they advise, manage, sponsor or refer you to, such as Fidelity funds.
facts.location: Form CRS, conflicts of interest
facts.quote: FBS or its affiliates typically earn more when you invest in a product that we or one of our affiliates advise, manage, sponsor, or refer you to, such as a Fidelity mutual fund, ETF, or managed account.

facts.display: Yes. Look up the details on Investor.gov/CRS or BrokerCheck.
facts.location: Form CRS, disciplinary history
facts.quote: Do you or your financial professionals have legal or disciplinary history? Yes.
